deliverable.description: a 45-minute lesson plan with a hands-on activity

goal: Plan a 45-minute lesson that helps my 7th graders understand photosynthesis well enough to explain it to a friend
audience: a 7th-grade science teacher (me) who will teach from the plan
context: 30 students, mixed reading levels, 4 English learners
We have spinach leaves, baking soda, syringes and cups, but no microscopes

sections.label: Hook
sections.text: a question students can argue about

sections.label: Mini-lesson
sections.text: inputs and outputs, with a diagram

sections.label: Exit ticket
sections.text: explain it to a friend in 3 sentences

constraints.text: Timings must add up to 45 minutes
Include one support for English learners
